summary: First-pass E2E testing of Loom & Pastel Co. ecommerce platform. 29/29 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend flows validated end-to-end: storefront home/shop/PDP, add-to-cart drawer, checkout with coupon (HELLO10) + mock Razorpay auto-verification, order success page, admin login (Owner), admin dashboard KPIs, all 11 admin sidebar sections navigable (products, orders, discounts, emails, settings verified). PWA manifest.json and service-worker.js served with 200. Fixed 2 backend 500 bugs (ObjectId leak on insert_one) inline.

minor.issue: Variant.sku is a required Pydantic field but admin_create_product does not auto-generate one — API returns 500 (validation) if client omits sku. Consider auto-generating a default SKU on create for smoother admin UX.

Linter flagged 30+ potential ObjectId leak sites. All active queries already use projection {_id:0} via _proj(), so no runtime failures observed, but insert_one() mutates the passed dict; two occurrences (checkout/place, admin/products) caused 500s and were patched. Recommend a global response cleaner or a MongoDB codec_options={type_registry} to strip _id defensively.

issues: HTML <title> is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be 'Loom & Pastel Co.' for SEO/branding

action_items: Update index.html <title> from 'Emergent | Fullstack App' to Loom & Pastel branding for SEO
Optional: auto-generate variant SKU server-side in POST /api/admin/products so admin UI does not need to supply it

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 720+ lines — recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, storefront, admin, webhooks) to improve maintainability once >700 line threshold is exceeded.

Post-insert response returns the same dict passed to insert_one which pymongo mutates by adding _id — this caused two 500 bugs (place_order + admin_create_product). Add a helper _strip(doc) or use pydantic response models.
checkout_quote is invoked twice from place_order (once via HTTP-ish call and again during processing) — minor perf/consistency: reuse the computed quote.
shipping_address doc conversion uses `hasattr(..., 'model_dump')` but by that point it's already a dict from model_dump on Order — dead branch; harmless but confusing.
No input validation on POST /api/checkout/place shipping_address (relies on ShippingAddress model, which is fine) but body['items'] could be empty leading to zero-total order — consider guard.
Analytics low_stock uses `async for` on full collection scan — fine for MVP scale but should be filtered ($elemMatch on variants.stock lt 5) for larger catalogs.

rca of the issue: 500 on POST /api/checkout/place and POST /api/admin/products — pymongo's insert_one mutates the passed dict by adding an ObjectId '_id'. Endpoints returned that same dict, causing FastAPI JSON encoder to fail on ObjectId. Fix: pop '_id' after insert_one. All find/find_one calls already use projection {_id:0} via _proj() helper.
